title: P1 arm L classification record
description: METHOD-P §1.2 arm L. The closed classification record a triage dispatch must return. Four ordinal axes, not five: `dynamism` appears in METHOD-P §1.2 but is not registered in spikes/p9/facets.toml, so it can feed no `require` row and no R(stage, ctx) — DECISIONS-2026-09-09 #2, lattice.py I8, F35-DRAFT.md:60. Anchors for every level live in spikes/prompts/p1-classify.md and are part of the card digest recorded on every arm-L record.

kind.description: The item's kind. Closed list from facets.toml [facet.kind]. Choose the kind the item IS, not the kind of work it will cause.

criticality.description: How much is at stake if this item is done wrong or not at all. See the anchors in the card; `unknown` when the item does not say.

novelty.description: How much of this work has no worked precedent in the codebase. See the anchors in the card; `unknown` when the item does not say.

size.description: How much work the item is, in changed surface. See the anchors in the card; `unknown` when the item does not say.

blast_radius.description: How far a defect introduced by this work would reach. See the anchors in the card; `unknown` when the item does not say.

market_facing.description: True when a person outside the engineering team would notice this change from the outside — a customer, a user, a buyer. False for changes visible only to contributors or operators.

external_dep.description: True when completing this item requires something the team does not control: a third-party service or API, another team's merge, a vendor, a purchase, a credential someone else issues.

has_repro.description: True when the item text contains steps, a command, a failing test, a stack trace or an input that would let a reader observe the problem themselves. False for a described symptom with no way to reach it. Always false for items that are not defects.

evidence.description: One entry for every axis and boolean above whose value is not `unknown`. Quote the item; never paraphrase. If an axis has no quotable support, its value is `unknown` (ordinal) or false (boolean) and it takes no evidence entry.

field.description: The record field this evidence is for.

quote.description: A verbatim span from the item that supports the value. Must appear in the item text character for character.

notes.description: Free text. UNTRUSTED and never a predicate input (process-catalog proposal §2.4): nothing here is read by the selection engine. Use it for what could not be expressed above, including why an axis is `unknown`.
